3.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!

4.t: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.

5.t: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.

6.t: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,

7.t: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.

8.t: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?

9.t: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,

10.t: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.

11.t: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

12.t: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.

13.t: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

14.t: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,

15.t: Then, on that day will the Event befall.

16.t: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.

17.t: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.

18.t: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.

19.t: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!

20.t: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.

21.t: Then he will be in blissful state

23.t: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.

24.t: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.

25.t: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book

26.t: And knew not what my reckoning!

27.t: Oh, would that it had been death!

28.t: My wealth hath not availed me,

29.t: My power hath gone from me.

30.t: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him

31.t: And then expose him to hell-fire

32.t: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.

33.t: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,

34.t: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.

35.t: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,

38.t: But nay! I swear by all that ye see

39.t: And all that ye see not

40.t: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.

41.t: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!

42.t: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!

43.t: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

44.t: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,

45.t: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand

47.t: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.

48.t: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).

49.t: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).

50.t: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.

51.t: And lo! it is absolute truth.

52.t: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
